name: invite-user-01
title: Invite User 01 - A Machine Being Authorised, Beside The Invitations Already Sent
description: An address, a role the caller names, a note the caller writes, one control and an announced status region, beside a bounded list of the invitations already sent under a heading of their own. The list is a second group and not a second form because a reader who cannot see the invitation they just sent will send another, and a second invitation is a support ticket. A stale invitation is dimmed rather than removed, on the caller's own signal. The role list is a readonly array so an as-const fixture compiles, and it is the caller's because the set of roles a workspace has is that workspace's own fact. Every string is passed in as a prop.
